mapper.select: select cr_team_room.resource_id, cr_team_room.team_template_id, cr_team_room.team_template_name, cr_team_room.NAME, cr_team_room.description, cr_team_room.sub_type, cr_team_room.pre_skills, cr_team_room.train_skills, cr_team_room.start_time, cr_team_room.end_time, cr_team_room.difficulty, cr_team_room.enable_recording, cr_team_room.time_line_config, cr_team_room.create_user_id, cr_team_room.modify_user_id, cr_team_room.local_scene_id, cr_team_room.copyed_topo_id, cr_team_room.training_status, cr_team_room.logo, cr_team_template.duration_time, cr_train_record.start_time scene_start_time, cr_train_record.end_time scene_end_time from cr_team_room left join cr_team_template on cr_team_room.team_template_id = cr_team_template.resource_id left join cr_train_record on cr_team_room.resource_id = cr_train_record.room_id where cr_team_room.resource_id = #{resourceId}

select sum(case when training_status = #{completedStatus} then 1 else 0 end) as completed, sum(case when training_status = #{completedStatus} then 0 else 1 end) as uncompleted from cr_team_room where resource_id in
#{roomId}
select case when exists(select 1 from cr_team_room where name = #{name}) then 1 else 0 end as result;

select date_format(start_time, '%Y') as month, count(*) as num from cr_team_room where xd_type in(1,2,3,4,5,6,7)

and YEAR(start_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())
group by month order by month;
